dct_description_sm: El Salvador administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 14 departamento - Admin 2: 48 municipio - Admin 3: 266 distrito Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 19 August 2024: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 29 May 2020: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 29 May 2020: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
